evidence.section: 3.1. Analysis of Phase and Microstructure Evolution
evidence.quote: At a low annealing temperature (≤800 ◦C), the elements of (FeNi)67Cr15Mn10Al5Ti3 HEA diffused through the grain boundary, and the solid solution became larger and precipitated out.

evidence.section: 3.1. Analysis of Phase and Microstructure Evolution
evidence.quote: At a higher annealing temperature (>800 ◦C), the mixing entropy of the alloying elements increased, diffusion at grain boundaries was suppressed, and the unevenly distributed elements presented with a uniform grain size.
The stable phase structure was consistent with the criterion of solid solution formation in HEA.

mechanisms.name: solid solution and precipitation of Al and Ti

evidence.quote: The transition of the solid solution microstructure of (FeNi)67Cr15Mn10Al5Ti3 HEA at the same annealing time was mainly caused by the solid solution and precipitation of Al and Ti in the FCC structure with the increasing temperature.
The homogenization of solid solution was the main process, and the growth of grains was difficult, which resulted in a non-monotonous relationship between the strength and the hardness.
